notes.title: Level select and part 3 change
notes.notes:
Hello,
I have added level select to the main menu so stuck players can continue to play. 
I have also removed the timed trap from level one third room. This room should be 
easier to complete now.

notes.title: Hints
notes.notes:
Added a hints menu within the pause menu.

Please only use this if you are completely stuck and can not solve the puzzle on your own. Every puzzle has hints and clues in the level, you just need to find them.
